derivation: by intro ω η h; apply ContinuousMap.ext; exact congrFun (denseRange_castOrderEmbedding.equalizer ω.continuous η.continuous h) _
explanation: `DenseRange.equalizer` says continuous functions into a T2 space that agree after composition with a dense-range map are equal. Applying it to the dense cast-order embedding gives equality of the paths from equality of their restrictions, hence injectivity.
